title: Case: Shipment is approaching its return-to-sender deadline
context: The parcel’s return timer is nearing its cutoff. The carrier permits a new collection arrangement if the verified recipient chooses before that cutoff.
initial_request: No recipient choice is recorded. Please contact authorised recipient Nalo Vere now, before the cutoff, rather than let the return timer expire.

acceptable_actions.summary: Contact the recipient to choose a permitted redelivery or collection option before the stated cutoff.

must_not: Only carrier confirmation establishes cancellation of the return; collection remains pending.
Treats the repeated copy of the request as a second, separate request (for example by sending two requests to the same team)
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: DL-6510 is due to return at 16:00 UTC today. Would you like redelivery on 2028-02-18 or depot collection on 2028-02-18? Please select an option so the carrier can stop the return.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-018: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The escalation message arrives twice; the key is the seed's. 6 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
